result.topic_en: Formal trigonometric-series expressions for the divisor function σ_s(n) and for the asymptotic expression (by the partition method) of r_{2s}(n), the number of representations of n as a sum of 2s squares.
result.transcription:
Add. Ms a 94^{18(23)} (23)

$\sigma_s(n) = n^s \sin\pi n \Big\{ \frac{1}{1^{s+1}\sin\pi n} + \frac{1}{2^{s+1}\tan\frac{1}{2}\pi n}$
$+ \frac{1}{3^{s+1}\sin\frac{1}{3}\pi n} + \frac{1}{4^{s+1}\tan\frac{1}{4}\pi n}$
$+ \frac{1}{5^{s+1}\sin\frac{1}{5}\pi n} + \frac{1}{6^{s+1}\tan\frac{1}{6}\pi n}$
$+ \cdots\cdots \Big\}$

$(1 + 2x + 2x^4 + 2x^9 + \cdots)^s = \sum r_s(n) x^n.$

If $s$ is an integer greater than 1, then the asymptotic expression of $r_{2s}(n)$ (by the partition method) is

$\frac{\pi^s n^{s-1}}{(s-1)!} \sin\pi n \Big\{ \frac{1}{1^s \sin\pi n} + \frac{1}{2^s \sin(\frac{1}{2}\pi n + \frac{1}{2}\pi s)}$
$+ \frac{1}{3^s \sin(\frac{1}{3}\pi n + \pi s)} + \frac{1}{4^s \sin(\frac{1}{4}\pi n + \frac{3}{2}\pi s)} +$
$\frac{1}{5^s \sin(\frac{1}{5}\pi n + 2\pi s)} + \cdots\cdots \Big\} \div$
$(1^{-s} + 3^{-s}\cos\pi s + 5^{-s}\cos 2\pi s + 7^{-s}\cos 3\pi s + \cdots).$
